context.content: For what you want to do, I would definitely recommend 32GB of RAM and at least a RTX 2060 SUPER. 2TB of SSD storage should be enough for your needs now. You can always add another 1TB 2.5" SSD later (hold on to everything that comes with the motherboard, power supply, etc. for the future). The motherboard comes with a header that you will need to make sure you connect while you're building, for the front panel usb-c port on the case. Have your motherboard manual out at all times, as well as any case instructions that came with your case too. Let me know if you have questions about anything else. Hope this helps you.
